bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 10 月 13 日低点

read.en: Teradyne fell 5.5% on Oct 14 to $359.44 on heavy volume and is down 13% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($385.0), 10-day ($407.6), 30-day ($383.6) and 100-day ($382.3) averages and above the 200-day ($343.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is still above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($441.6), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月14日放量下跌 5.5%，收于 $359.44，五个交易日下跌 13%。股价位于 5 日（$385.0）、10 日（$407.6）、30 日（$383.6）和 100 日均线（$382.3）下方，并在 200 日均线（$343.3）上方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$441.6），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The Oct 13 low ($362.6) broke, with a day's low of $354.74, and is now first resistance, then $382–385 (30, 100 and 5-day averages) and $408 (10-day). Support is $343 (200-day average; Jun 9 low $340.3), then $326 (September lows) and $297–301 (late-July lows). A close below $340 would open $326.
